method.method_draft: Describe the structure visually first, then count only visible non-H bond strokes while disregarding arrows. Moving left to right: count O-C = 1, left C-central C = 1, central C-carbonyl C = 1, carbonyl C=O = 2, carbonyl C-O = 1, ester O-ethyl C = 1, and ethyl C-C = 1. Exclude O-H and C-H. Add these contributions to get 8.
